Sifakas are bouncy lemurs that are found exclusively on the island of Madagascar. Their hind legs are strong and powerful, adapted for jumping between trees. They move on the ground by hopping between locations. These lemurs are herbivores, and are often seen snacking on fruit, flowers, seeds, leaves, bark, and other plants.
